ad.headline: The #1 Dashboard for Factory Performance
ad.body: Stop guessing why the line stopped. Northline is the operating system for modern plants — live downtime, output, and shift notes in one board. Built for teams that want to move faster.

page.headline: The #1 Dashboard for Factory Performance
page.body: Northline gives every site one live picture of the floor. See what is running, what is down, and what to do next — without another spreadsheet or a walk to the line.

personas.name: Klaus
personas.quote: A '#1' with no number behind it tells me nothing.
personas.reason: Objects to slogans without proof — and there is no price on the page.

personas.name: Anika
personas.quote: No price anywhere. I am not clicking just to find out.
personas.reason: Will not click when the price is missing.

personas.name: Mateo
personas.quote: Who says you are #1? There is no source.

personas.name: Jules
personas.quote: Wait — this is like a hot OS for my side hustle.
personas.reason: Reads “operating system for modern plants” as a consumer app and would click. She will never buy.
